registeredBy: Sam (owner); registered on his instruction to close the predictive econometrics gaps, before any run of this test
hypothesis: An ARMA(p, q) forecast of quarterly real GDP growth (q/q), p and q each 0 to 2 chosen by BIC at the first origin of each year, coefficients re-estimated by exact maximum likelihood at every origin on all data to then, has a lower RMSE than the historical mean, one and four quarters ahead.
knownLimits: A different model class (moving-average terms added) on the same data, sample, benchmark and pass mark as gdp_forecast v1, which failed; it is a separate test, not a version of that one, and the AR verdict stands whatever this one finds.
Order chosen once a year; coefficients every quarter.
Registered together with cpi_forecast_arma; the Holm correction counts every test on record.
